item: The two-process dismissal-reason test no longer loops the parent past the store's 1000-entry cap
summary: The test failed once on CI (PR 1466): the parent recorded reasons for as long as the child lived, the child took seconds to start on that runner, the parent wrote 1547 reasons, and the store (cap 1000) correctly dropped the oldest 587. Not a lost update: reproduced locally with a child that sleeps 6 s before writing (2493 written, missing = the contiguous prefix parent-0..parent-1532, every child reason present), which is exactly the cap. The parent now starts when the child announces it is writing and stops at cap minus 40; a second test pins that past the cap the oldest go in order and the newest are all kept. Red without (the old form with a slow child).
